procedures.name: Capsulotomy left breast, flat advancement V to Y left breast for correction lower pole defect

course.narrative: A 35-year-old female with left breast lower pole flatness secondary to previous surgeries underwent capsulotomy and V-Y flat advancement of the left breast under LMA anesthesia. Preoperative markings were performed in the upright position. The previous inverted T-scar was excised, the breast was dissected off the underlying capsule and pectoralis muscle, and a superior-based capsular flap was created to allow implant descent. The inferior edge of the capsule was sutured to the inframammary flap, and the vertical incision was extended by 2 cm to correct the lower pole defect. Hemostasis was achieved, the pocket was copiously irrigated, and the incisions were closed in layers. Estimated blood loss was negligible, and sponge/instrument/needle counts were correct.
